listeningStage2Data.sentence: We need to _______ the use of plastic bags to protect our Earth.
listeningStage2Data.hint: need to 後面接原形動詞，意思為「減少」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 我們需要減少塑膠袋的使用以保護地球。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: The heavy rain forced the school to _______ the outdoor sports day.
listeningStage2Data.hint: force someone to 後接原形動詞，表示「取消」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 大雨迫使學校取消了戶外運動會。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: Please stay calm and do not _______ when the fire alarm rings.
listeningStage2Data.hint: 助動詞 do not 後接原形動詞，指陷入「恐慌」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 當火警響起時，請保持冷靜，不要恐慌。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: Emma is very _______ and makes friends easily wherever she goes.
listeningStage2Data.hint: be動詞後面接形容詞，指性格「外向的」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 艾瑪非常外向，無論走到哪裡都能輕鬆交到朋友。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: Tom _______ eats fast food because he prefers healthy home-cooked meals.
listeningStage2Data.hint: 頻率副詞放在一般動詞前面，表示「很少」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 湯姆很少吃速食，因為他比較喜歡健康的手煮家常菜。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: She can speak _______ English because she practices talking every day.
listeningStage2Data.hint: 修飾著名詞 English 的形容詞，表示「流利的」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 她能說流利的英語，因為她每天都練習說話。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: Thousands of excited fans went to the stadium for the rock _______.
listeningStage2Data.hint: 一場聚集觀眾的音樂演出。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 數千名興奮的歌迷前往體育場參加搖滾音樂會。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: Good learning habits _______ regular practice and full attention.
listeningStage2Data.hint: 主詞是複數名詞，動詞用原形，表示「需要」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 良好的學習習慣需要規律的練習與全然的專注。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: Birds have the amazing _______ to fly high across the wide sky.
listeningStage2Data.hint: the ability to + 原形動詞，表示做某事的「能力」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 鳥類擁有在遼闊天空中高飛的驚人能力。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: You can borrow my bicycle _______ you return it before five o'clock.
listeningStage2Data.hint: 連接詞片語引導條件子句，意思是「只要」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 只要你在五點前歸還，你就可以借用我的腳踏車。

listeningStage3Data.title: The School Talent Show (學校才藝表演)

articleContent.en: Leo is an outgoing boy who loves music very much.
articleContent.zh: 里奧是個非常熱愛音樂且外向的男孩。

articleContent.en: He rarely gets nervous, but today there is a big concert in the school hall.
articleContent.zh: 他很少感到緊張，但今天學校大廳有一場大型音樂會。

articleContent.en: A huge audience sits quietly, waiting for Leo's performance.
articleContent.zh: 龐大的觀眾安靜地坐著，等待里奧的表演。

articleContent.en: Teachers allow students to invite their families as long as they arrive on time.
articleContent.zh: 老師們允許學生邀請家人，只要他們準時抵達。

articleContent.en: Leo plays the piano smoothly with great confidence and ability.
articleContent.zh: 里奧帶著極大的自信與能力流暢地彈奏鋼琴。

articleContent.en: Everyone cheers warmly when the music ends.
articleContent.zh: 當音樂結束時，每個人都熱情地歡呼。

questions.question: Who is performing music on the stage?
What event takes place in the school hall today?
How could the family members enter the hall?
options: As long as they arrived on time
Early in the morning before sunrise
questions.correct: As long as they arrived on time

questions.question: Where does the audience gather to watch the performance?
What instrument does Leo play with great ability?
Why did the audience cheer warmly at the end?
options: Because Leo gave a wonderful performance
Because they wanted to leave early
questions.correct: Because Leo gave a wonderful performance

listeningStage3Data.title: Meeting an Important Client (會見重要客戶)

articleContent.en: Mr. Brown works in a busy office in Taipei.
articleContent.zh: 布朗先生在台北一間繁忙的辦公室工作。

articleContent.en: Yesterday, an important client visited him to discuss a new project.
articleContent.zh: 昨天，一位重要客戶拜訪他討論新專案。

articleContent.en: Mr. Brown prepared a detailed product sample on the meeting table.
articleContent.zh: 布朗先生在會議桌上準備了一份詳細的產品樣本。

articleContent.en: The client was impressed because Mr. Brown spoke fluent English.
articleContent.zh: 這位客戶印象深刻，因為布朗先生說著流利的英語。

articleContent.en: The company's new design will require three months to finish.
articleContent.zh: 公司的新設計將需要三個月來完成。

articleContent.en: Both sides signed the agreement happily before lunch.
articleContent.zh: 雙方在午餐前開心地簽署了協議。

questions.question: Who visited Mr. Brown at his office yesterday?
What did Mr. Brown show on the meeting table?
When did both sides sign the agreement?
Where did the business discussion take place?
options: In a busy office in Taipei
questions.correct: In a busy office in Taipei

questions.question: What language skill did Mr. Brown demonstrate during the meeting?
Why did the client feel impressed during the meeting?
options: Because Mr. Brown spoke fluent English
Because there was a sudden panic
questions.correct: Because Mr. Brown spoke fluent English

listeningStage3Data.title: Safety Drill at School (學校安全演習)

articleContent.en: On Friday morning, the loud bell sounded for a fire emergency drill.
articleContent.zh: 週五早晨，響亮的鐘聲響起進行火災緊急演習。

articleContent.en: The teachers told students not to panic or run in the hallway.
articleContent.zh: 老師們告訴學生不要恐慌或在走廊上奔跑。

articleContent.en: Everyone walked calmly down the stairs to reduce potential accidents.
articleContent.zh: 每個人冷靜地走下樓梯以減少潛在的意外。

articleContent.en: The weather was bad, so the principal had to cancel the outdoor speech.
articleContent.zh: 天氣很差，所以校長不得不取消戶外演講。

articleContent.en: They gathered safely inside the gym instead.
articleContent.zh: 他們改為安全地聚集在體育館內。

articleContent.en: All the classes followed the safety rules perfectly.
articleContent.zh: 所有的班級都完美地遵守了安全守則。

questions.question: Who instructed the students not to panic in the hallway?
What drill was held at school on Friday morning?
When did the loud emergency bell ring?
Where did the students gather after leaving the classrooms?
What event did the principal cancel due to bad weather?
Why did the students walk calmly down the stairs?

readingStage2Data.title: The Bremen Town Musicians (不來梅樂隊)
readingStage2Data.article: An old donkey decided to leave his farm to become a musician in Bremen. Along the way, he met a dog, a cat, and a rooster who had the {{1}} to sing loudly. The four animals became friends {{2}} they all shared the same dream of freedom. At night, they found a house filled with robbers eating a rich dinner. To drive them away, the animals made a huge noise together, which sounded like a strange and wild {{3}}. The frightened robbers ran into the dark woods and never returned.

blanks.hint: 名詞，表示某種天賦或做某事的「能力」。
blanks.translation: 沿途上，他遇見了一隻狗、一隻貓和一隻擁有大聲歌唱能力的公雞。
因為他們都懷抱著對自由的同一個夢想，這四隻動物便成為了好友。

blanks.hint: 名詞，指由多種聲音或樂器匯聚而成的「音樂會」。
blanks.translation: 為了趕走他們，動物們一起製造出巨大的聲響，聽起來就像是一場奇特又狂野的音樂會。

readingStage2Data.title: Robin Hood and the Golden Arrow (羅賓漢與金箭)
readingStage2Data.article: The Sheriff of Nottingham planned an archery contest to trap Robin Hood in town. He knew the legendary archer could not resist showing his supreme skill. However, heavy rains caused an unexpected {{1}} in the flooded courtyard, threatening the event. The sheriff refused to {{2}} the grand competition because he wanted to catch the outlaw. Disguised as a poor beggar, Robin secretly sent a hidden {{3}} of his finest green arrow to the guards to announce his arrival before winning the gold and escaping into Sherwood Forest.

blanks.hint: 名詞，指暴雨引發的危險「緊急事件」。
blanks.translation: 然而，暴雨在積水的中庭引發了意想不到的緊急事件，威脅到賽事的進行。

blanks.hint: 原形動詞，接在 refused to 之後，表示「取消」。
blanks.translation: 郡長拒絕取消這場盛大的比賽，因為他一心想要逮捕這位法外之徒。

blanks.hint: 名詞，指作為代表物品的「樣本、樣品」。
blanks.translation: 羅賓偽裝成貧窮的乞丐，在奪得黃金並逃進雪伍德森林之前，暗中將他最精良的綠色箭矢樣本送交給衛兵以宣告現身。

readingStage2Data.title: King Midas and the Golden Touch (邁達斯國王與金手指)
readingStage2Data.article: King Midas loved gold more than anything else in the whole world. A mysterious visitor granted his wish to turn whatever he touched into gold, but this gift soon caused a terrible {{1}}. When he tried to eat a meal, the bread turned into hard metal before he could swallow it. Hungry and desperate, the weeping king begged the god to {{2}} his foolish wish. The god felt pity and told him that washing in the river would cure the curse, {{3}} he truly learned to value life above gold.

blanks.hint: 名詞，指因無法進食而面臨威脅生命的「緊急狀況」。
blanks.translation: 一位神秘的訪客實現了他的願望，讓他摸到的任何東西都變成黃金，但這份禮物很快引發了一場可怕的緊急危機。

blanks.hint: 原形動詞，不定詞 to 後接原形，表示「取消」。
blanks.translation: 又餓又絕望的國王哭泣著祈求神明取消他愚蠢的願望。

blanks.hint: 連接詞片語引導條件子句，意思是「只要」。
blanks.translation: 神明心生憐憫，並告訴他只要他真正學會珍惜生命勝過黃金，在河中清洗就能解除詛咒。

readingStage3Data.title: The Bremen Town Musicians (不來梅樂隊)

articleContent.en: An old donkey decided to leave his farm to become a musician in Bremen.
articleContent.zh: 一隻老驢子決定離開農場，前往不來梅成為一名音樂家。

articleContent.en: Along the way, he met a dog, a cat, and a rooster who had the ability to sing loudly.
articleContent.zh: 沿途上，他遇見了一隻狗、一隻貓和一隻擁有大聲歌唱能力的公雞。

articleContent.en: The four animals became friends because they all shared the same dream of freedom.
articleContent.zh: 因為他們都懷抱著對自由的同一個夢想，這四隻動物便成為了好友。

articleContent.en: At night, they found a house filled with robbers eating a rich dinner.
articleContent.zh: 夜晚，他們發現了一間屋子，裡面坐滿了正在享用豐盛晚餐的強盜。

articleContent.en: To drive them away, the animals made a huge noise together, which sounded like a strange and wild concert.
articleContent.zh: 為了趕走他們，動物們一起製造出巨大的聲響，聽起來就像是一場奇特又狂野的音樂會。

articleContent.en: The frightened robbers ran into the dark woods and never returned.
articleContent.zh: 受驚嚇的強盜們逃進了黑暗的森林，再也沒有回來。

questions.question: Who decided to leave the farm first to become a musician?
What special talent did the rooster possess?
options: The skill to swim across rivers
The speed to run faster than horses

questions.question: When did the animals discover the house in the woods?
Where did the frightened robbers run after hearing the noise?
What did the animals' loud noise sound like to the robbers?
options: A whisper in the gentle wind

questions.question: Why did the four animals agree to travel together?
options: Because they shared the same dream of freedom
Because they wanted to buy expensive jewelry
Because they were searching for their lost owners
questions.correct: Because they shared the same dream of freedom

readingStage3Data.title: Robin Hood and the Golden Arrow (羅賓漢與金箭)

articleContent.en: The Sheriff of Nottingham planned an archery contest to trap Robin Hood in town.
articleContent.zh: 諾丁漢郡長策劃了一場射箭比賽，打算在鎮上誘捕羅賓漢。

articleContent.en: He knew the legendary archer could not resist showing his supreme skill.
articleContent.zh: 他知道這位傳奇神射手無法抗拒展現高超技藝的機會。

articleContent.en: However, heavy rains caused an unexpected emergency in the flooded courtyard, threatening the event.
articleContent.zh: 然而，暴雨在積水的中庭引發了意想不到的緊急事件，威脅到賽事的進行。

articleContent.en: The sheriff refused to cancel the grand competition because he wanted to catch the outlaw.
articleContent.zh: 郡長拒絕取消這場盛大的比賽，因為他一心想要逮捕這位法外之徒。

articleContent.en: Disguised as a poor beggar, Robin secretly sent a hidden sample of his finest green arrow to the guards to announce his arrival before winning the gold and escaping into Sherwood Forest.
articleContent.zh: 羅賓偽裝成貧窮的乞丐，在奪得黃金並逃進雪伍德森林之前，暗中將他最精良的綠色箭矢樣本送交給衛兵以宣告現身。

questions.question: Who planned an archery contest to capture Robin Hood?
What kind of crisis did the sudden storm cause in the courtyard?
options: A quiet night of heavy snowfall
A terrible shortage of sweet food

questions.question: When did Robin Hood reveal his presence to the guards?
options: After being locked inside the dungeon
Many weeks after leaving the country

questions.question: Where did Robin Hood quickly escape after taking the prize?
options: Behind the high city castle wall

questions.question: What special item did Robin give the guards as a secret sign?
options: A sample of his finest green arrow
A golden ring belonging to the king
A bag of stolen silver coins
questions.correct: A sample of his finest green arrow

questions.question: Why did the sheriff refuse to stop the outdoor competition?
options: Because he wanted to trap Robin Hood
Because the weather became bright and warm
Because all the villagers begged to see the show
questions.correct: Because he wanted to trap Robin Hood

readingStage3Data.title: King Midas and the Golden Touch (邁達斯國王與金手指)

articleContent.en: King Midas loved gold more than anything else in the whole world.
articleContent.zh: 邁達斯國王熱愛黃金勝過世界上的一切事物。

articleContent.en: A mysterious visitor granted his wish to turn whatever he touched into gold, but this gift soon caused a terrible emergency.
articleContent.zh: 一位神秘的訪客實現了他的願望，讓他摸到的任何東西都變成黃金，但這份禮物很快引發了一場可怕的緊急危機。

articleContent.en: When he tried to eat a meal, the bread turned into hard metal before he could swallow it.
articleContent.zh: 當他試圖用餐時，麵包還沒來得及吞下就變成了堅硬的金屬。

articleContent.en: Hungry and desperate, the weeping king begged the god to cancel his foolish wish.
articleContent.zh: 又餓又絕望的國王哭泣著祈求神明取消他愚蠢的願望。

articleContent.en: The god felt pity and told him that washing in the river would cure the curse, as long as he truly learned to value life above gold.
articleContent.zh: 神明心生憐憫，並告訴他只要他真正學會珍惜生命勝過黃金，在河中清洗就能解除詛咒。

questions.question: Who made a greedy wish to turn everything into gold?
What serious emergency did the king face during his meal?
options: His food turned into hard gold metal
Poisonous snakes entered the dining hall
Strong thieves stole all the royal plates
questions.correct: His food turned into hard gold metal

questions.question: When was the golden curse finally removed from the king?
options: After he washed his hands in the river
Before the mysterious visitor left the palace
When he counted ten thousand silver coins
questions.correct: After he washed his hands in the river

questions.question: Where did the magical transformation of food happen?
What item turned into hard metal before the king could eat it?
Why did the god agree to lift the magical curse?
options: Because King Midas truly regretted his greed
Because the king offered a large sum of money
Because the soldiers threatened to attack the visitor
questions.correct: Because King Midas truly regretted his greed
